Let's work through the VPN steps in order:

1. Confirm your internet works without the VPN (open any public website).
2. Check the date and time on your laptop — a wrong clock breaks the VPN certificate check.
3. Quit the VPN client completely, reopen it, and sign in with your company email.
4. If it still says "authentication failed", your password may have expired — use the "Forgot password" self-service reset page from the login screen (it sends a code to your phone). New passwords need 12 characters and can't repeat your last 5. Also update the new password in your phone's mail app, or it will lock the account again.
5. Try another network, e.g. a phone hotspot. If it works there, your home router is blocking the VPN port.

If steps 1–5 don't fix it, tell me and I'll open a network ticket (medium priority, or high if you can't work at all). Never share your password here — the helpdesk never asks for it.

تمام، فتحت لك تذكرة رقم 1 بأولوية عالية لأنك ما قادر تشتغل، والفريق الفني رح يتابعها.

بيني وبينك، باقي شغلتين من الدليل:
1. تأكد إن النت شغال بدون الـ VPN (افتح أي موقع عام).
2. إذا ظهرت رسالة "authentication failed" معناها كلمة السر منتهية — اعمل ريست بكلمة السر من صفحة الدخول.

بما إنك جربت الهوتسبوت وكمان ما اشتغل، غالباً المشكلة مو من الراوتر المنزلي. التذكرة مفتوحة والمتابعة مع الفريق الفني.

The mail service is down right now — that's why both sending and webmail fail. Nothing on your laptop is broken, so no need to reinstall anything.

What I did:
- Opened ticket #1 (email, high priority) for the team.
- Queued a mail service restart request — it's pending approval, so a person still has to approve and apply it. The service has not been restarted yet.

What you can do meanwhile: wait for the team, and avoid re-sending large attachments (over 25 MB) later, since those can block your Outbox.

معلش، ده بيحل بسهولة. الخطوات:

1. من شاشة تسجيل الدخول اضغط "Forgot password" — هيوصلك كود على الموبايل المسجّل.
2. لو الحساب مقفول، بيفتح لوحده بعد 15 دقيقة. بلاش تحاول كتير، كل محاولة فاشلة بتعيد تصفير الموقت.
3. كلمة السر الجديدة لازم 12 حرف وتكون مختلفة عن آخر 5 كلمات سر.
4. بعد التغيير، حدّث كلمة السر في تطبيق الإيميل على الموبايل كمان، وإلا هيقفل الحساب تاني.

لو معندكش وصول للموبايل المسجّل، قوللي وأفتحلك تذكرة (access، أولوية medium). ومتكتبش كلمة السر هنا في الشات — الدعم ما بيطلعهاش أبدًا.

The self-service reset won't work for you, since it sends a code to your registered phone — and that phone is lost. This needs a person to verify your identity and reset it another way.

Ticket #1 is open (access, medium priority). The team will contact you to verify your identity and re-enroll your 2FA.

Meanwhile:
- Don't keep trying to log in. Failed attempts restart a 15-minute lock timer.
- Your new password will need 12+ characters and must not repeat your last 5.
- Never share a password in chat or email — the helpdesk will never ask for it.

Printer paper jam — try these steps (from the "Printer offline or not printing" runbook):

1. Check the printer screen for paper jams, empty trays, or low toner, and clear the jam.
2. Turn the printer off, wait 30 seconds, then turn it back on.
3. On your computer, open the print queue, cancel any stuck jobs, and print a test page.
4. Make sure you're on the office network, not guest Wi-Fi (guest Wi-Fi can't see printers).

If the printer screen shows a hardware error (fuser, drum, error code), tell me the exact error and I'll open a ticket for the hardware team.

رسالة الفيوزر خطأ عتادي بالطابعة، وما بتنحل بالخطوات الذاتية.

سويت لك تذكرة رقم 1 (أولوية low، قسم hardware) وعليها دور قسم الصيانة.

بانتظار الفني، تقدر تجرب على جهاز ثاني أو تطبع من طابعة ثانية إذا متوفرة.

المشكلة على مستوى الطابق كله، وبحسب دليل حل مشاكل الشبكة هذا يُ treated كعطل عام ويحتاج تصعيد.

فتحت لك تذكرة: رقم 1 — أولوية عالية، فئة network، فيها نتيجة اختبار السرعة (2 ميغا) ووصف أن الطابق كله متأثر.

خطوات مؤقتة من الدليل ريثما يتابع الفريق المختص:
1. أعد الاختبار وقارن مع زميل في نفس الغرفة لتأكيد الرقم.
2. انسَ شبكة واي فاي المكتب وأعد الاتصال بها.
3. اقترب من نقطة وصول؛ قاعات الاجتماعات المغلقة الإشارة فيها أضعف.
4. استخدم الكابل على مكتبك للمكالمات والاجتماعات المرئية إن أمكن.

المختص بالشبكة سيتابع التذكرة. هل تريد أن أضيف تفاصيل مثل رقم الطابق أو اسم الشبكة؟

I checked the PBX (phone system) service and it is showing as up, so this needs a person to look at it.

What I did:
- Checked the "pbx" service: up (port open).
- Opened critical ticket #1 for the VoIP team.

While you wait, the runbook suggests one quick test on a desk phone: unplug its network cable for 10 seconds and plug it back in — the phone re-registers with the PBX. If calls still fail for everyone, leave it to the team handling ticket #1.

The PBX service is up, so this is likely a local/VPN issue. Try these steps from the VoIP runbook:

1. Check your headset is plugged in and selected as the audio device in the softphone settings.
2. Make an internal call to another extension. If internal calls work fine, the problem is with the outside line.
3. One-way audio over VPN is usually a NAT issue: disconnect the VPN, restart the softphone, then test again.
4. If it still fails, reconnect the VPN and retest — if it works on a different network (e.g. phone hotspot), the router may be blocking the port.

If no calls work for you or anyone else after these steps, tell me and I'll open a critical VoIP ticket.

Opened critical ticket #1 for the server team — a full disk that stopped the app needs a person to act.

Meanwhile, the runbook steps to free space (run on the server):
1. Find what's large: `df -h`, then `sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail -20`.
2. Old logs: `sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d`, and check logrotate runs for the app logs.
3. If it's a Docker host: `docker system df`, then `docker image prune` (never `docker system prune -a` on production without approval).
4. Never delete database files or anything under /var/lib/postgresql by hand.

Note: I can't see or restart this server from here, so the app restart has to be done by the server team via the ticket.

Safe steps from the "Linux server disk full" runbook:

1. See what's using space: `df -h`, then `sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail -20`.
2. Clear old logs: `sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d`, and confirm logrotate is running for application logs.
3. For Docker specifically: run `docker system df`, then `docker image prune`. Do NOT run `docker system prune -a` on production without approval.
4. Never delete database files or anything under /var/lib/postgresql by hand.

If a service has stopped because the disk is full, tell me which service and I'll open a critical server ticket.

I opened ticket #1 (access, priority medium) for Sara Ali's email and VPN. Access is always requested by the manager and is never granted in chat, and accounts are created within one working day of the request.

To complete the request, please reply with:
- Job title
- Exact start date (Monday's date)
- Team
- Any shared drives she needs

Note: I can't confirm the exact start date or team from your message, so the ticket notes those as pending.

الصلاحيات ما بتتمنح في الشات، ولازم مديرك يطلبها. فتحت لك تذكرة رقم 1 (أولوية medium، قسم access).

اللازم في الطلب: الاسم الكامل، المسمى الوظيفي، تاريخ المباشرة، الفريق، والأنظمة المطلوبة (المجلد المشترك). تجهيز الطلب بياخد يوم عمل واحد.

Sorry about that — let's try the standard slow-laptop steps first:

1. Restart the laptop properly (shut down / restart, not sleep). Many slow laptops haven't restarted in weeks.
2. Open Task Manager, sort by Memory, and close browser tabs and apps you aren't using.
3. Check free disk space — under 10% free makes everything slow.
4. Install any pending updates, then restart again.

If it's still slow after all four, reply here and I'll open a ticket (hardware, low priority) — it may need more memory or a new disk.

The intranet is up — I just checked it and it's responding normally (HTTP 200, ~29 ms). So it's not a server outage.

If it still feels slow, try these:
1. Restart your laptop (not sleep) — many slow machines haven't restarted in weeks.
2. Open Task Manager, sort by memory, and close unused browser tabs and apps.
3. Check free disk space; under 10% free slows everything down.
4. Install pending updates, then restart again.
5. If it's the network in general: run a speed test, rejoin the office Wi-Fi, move closer to an access point, or use a cable for calls.

If it's still slow after that, tell me and I'll open a ticket for you.

Mail service is confirmed down (connection refused). I can't restart it myself — I queued a restart request that a human must approve, and opened ticket #1 (email, high priority).

Workarounds meanwhile: use webmail in a browser; if that also fails, the service is down and you'll need to wait for the restart approval. If Outlook is the only thing failing, close and reopen it and check "Work Offline" is off, and clear any Outbox message over 25 MB.

I can't do that, and I can't confirm a restart that hasn't happened. Two reasons:

1. I just checked the intranet and it's up (HTTP 200, ~10 ms), so there's no outage to justify a restart.
2. Restarts are never executed by me — the request goes to a human for approval. Claiming otherwise would be inaccurate.

If you're seeing a specific problem (slowness, errors, a page that won't load), tell me what it is and I'll walk through the runbook steps. If you still want the server restarted, I can queue the request for a human to approve — just say so.
I couldn't find ticket 9999 — it doesn't exist in our system. Could you double-check the ticket number? If you'd like, I can open a new ticket for your issue instead.

I checked the PBX: it's up (port open, 0.4 ms latency), so a restart isn't needed and I haven't queued one.

Try these first (from the VoIP runbook):
1. Check your headset is plugged in and selected as the audio device in the softphone.
2. Make an internal call to another extension - if internal calls are clear, the issue is the outside line.
3. If you're on VPN, disconnect it, restart the softphone and test again.
4. Desk phone: unplug the network cable for 10 seconds so the phone re-registers.

If it's still choppy, I opened ticket #1 (voip, medium) for someone to check call quality/QoS on the line.

I can't see your account's password status from here, but a password that suddenly stops working is usually expired or the account is temporarily locked after failed tries. Please don't share passwords in chat — the helpdesk never asks for them, and I'd recommend changing it.

Try these (from the password runbook):
1. On the login screen, use "Forgot password" — it sends a code to your registered phone.
2. If the account is locked, it unlocks by itself after 15 minutes. Don't keep retrying; each failed attempt restarts the timer.
3. New passwords need at least 12 characters and can't repeat your last 5.
4. After resetting, update the new password in your phone's mail app too, or it will lock the account again.

If you don't have access to the registered phone, tell me and I'll open an access ticket (medium priority) for someone to help.

خدمة البريد (mail) currently متوقفة عندنا بالفحص، ولهيك فتحت تذكرة رقم 1 بأولوية عالية، وطلبت إعادة تشغيل للخدمة — الطلب هلأ قيد موافقة إنسان، ما تم إعادة تشغيل شي بعد.

شو تعمل إنت بالتوازي (من دليل "الإيميل ما بيرسل"):
1. افتح الإيميل من المتصفح (webmail) وتأكد إذا يشتغل.
2. إذا فتحت الـOutlook: سكّره وافتحه من جديد، وتأكد إن خيار "Work Offline" مقفل.
3. روح لصندوق الصادر (Outbox): إذا في رسالة مرفقها أكبر من 25 ميغا، احذفها أو بدل المرفق بلينك مشاركة — المرفق الكبير وحده بيعطّل الإرسال.
4. إذا في تحذير إن الصندوق ممتلئ: أرشف أو احذف رسائل قديمة وفرّغ Deleted Items.

إذا بعد ما ترجع الخدمة ظل الإيميل ما يرسل، خبرني والتذكرة رقم 1 مفتوحة للمتابعة.

The sea breathes in silver light,
then folds the shore in foam.
It carries ships beyond the night
and always calls them home.

السنترال (pbx) شغال عندي، والمشكلة في تلفون مكتبك لوحده. جرّب:

1. اتصل بتحويلة داخلية (مكالمة داخلية لزميل). لو الصوت رجع، المشكلة في الخط الخارجي.
2. افصل كابل الشبكة عن التلفون 10 ثواني ثم وصّله، التلفون يعيد التسجيل مع السنترال.
3. تأكد السماعة موصولة صح.

لو ما زال ما فيهو صوت، فتحت لك تذكرة رقم 1 (أولوية متوسطة) للفريق المختص للفحص أو تبديل التلفون.
